merit-website.title: Is aspiretech.us Merit's website?
merit-website.body: It is the website on file for Merit. The logo taken from it is Aspire's, so it was refused. If the site is not Merit's, what was read from it may not be Merit's either. Merit sells license portability to state licensing boards.
facts: whether Merit and Aspire are one company

answers.label: That is Merit's site
answers.done: Kept, and recorded as your answer.
next: aspiretech.us stays on file, with your answer recorded.
The nightly tries the site's next logo; a guessed one comes to Logos to check.

answers.label: Not theirs: find the right one
answers.done: Recorded. Claude's inbox has the search.
next: Your answer is recorded; nothing on Merit's page changes yet.
Claude's inbox gets the job: find Merit's real website, with a skeptic.
A site they agree on comes to Website review for you.

no.ask: Find Merit's own website (license portability for state licensing boards). aspiretech.us carries Aspire's logo; the owner says it is not Merit's. Reader + skeptic; land the answer in Website review.

miami-dade-sheriff-s-training-center.title: Miami-Dade Sheriff's Training Center: a government body, or a seller?
miami-dade-sheriff-s-training-center.body: On 28 October a reader and a skeptic took 156 public bodies off the supplier list. They held this one: a county sheriff's training academy, filed off the IACP 2026 floor, that may sell courses.

answers.label: Government body: take it off
answers.done: Taken off the supplier list, like the other 156.
next: Marked not a supplier, with your words as the reason.
It stops appearing in the supplier export.

answers.label: It sells courses: keep it
answers.done: Kept, and recorded as your answer.
next: It publishes only once a website is confirmed for it.

gov.why: a county sheriff's training academy, a government body
